actions.action: Move plant to sunniest (south/west) window, shifting it closer over about a week
Give the pot a quarter turn each week
Cut stem 2-3 cm below top rosette, leaving leaves on stump
Twist off 3-4 plump lower leaves for propagation
Let rosette and leaves callus on paper towel for 3-7 days
Set callused rosette and leaves on dry succulent/cactus soil in bright light
Mist the propagation soil lightly once a week until roots appear
Check stump's soil weekly with finger 3-4 cm deep
Water the stump when soil is completely dry

reason: The answer correctly identifies etiolation and recommends more light plus beheading and propagation, matching the thread's fix, with no harmful advice.
